WITH RECURSIVE subclasses AS (
  SELECT cb.class_symbol_id AS symbol_id, 1 AS inheritance_depth
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  WHERE cb.base_symbol_id = 'src/click/exceptions.py::ClickException'
    AND s.file_id LIKE 'src/click/%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, sc.inheritance_depth + 1
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN subclasses sc ON cb.base_symbol_id = sc.symbol_id
  JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
  WHERE s.file_id LIKE 'src/click/%'
)
SELECT symbol_id, MIN(inheritance_depth) AS inheritance_depth
FROM subclasses
GROUP BY symbol_id
ORDER BY inheritance_depth, symbol_id
